literal_meaning: কাটা-কাটা (ছেদন করা অংশগুলোর মতো আলাদা আলাদা)
figurative_meaning_en: clear and distinct, without gaps or ambiguity
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথা কাটাকাটা, কোনো অস্পষ্টতা নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: His words were clear-cut, with no ambiguity.
The letters in the book are printed distinctly.
note: Refers to clarity in expression, often used in everyday Bengali speech.
